disk.subtitle: Scan a drive or folder and find what is taking up the most space
disk.filesTruncated: {n} files in total (the list loads the largest ones only)
disk.selectAllHint: Selects only what is loaded in the list — the list keeps the largest entries; use “Show more” to load beyond that
disk.topFilesHint: Click to reveal in the file manager
disk.emptyTitle: Pick a drive or folder to start
disk.emptyHint: The scan totals every folder's size and file count and lists the largest files on the drive; it is read-only and never modifies anything.
disk.deleteMsg: Move {n} item(s) ({size}) to the system Recycle Bin; they can be restored from there (the Recycle Bin still occupies the space until emptied).
disk.deleteTooMany: At most {max} items per run — please delete in batches
disk.deletedToast: Moved {n} item(s) to the Recycle Bin
disk.staleNotice: Sizes adjusted in place after deletion · rescan to fully refresh
disk.rootCrossDrive: Note: {path} is a link to {real} — what you see below is the real location's content on another drive; scan that drive to see it as its own data
disk.rootIsLink: Note: {path} is a link to {real} — what you see below is the real location's content
disk.migrateWarn: Close any app using this folder before migrating; pick a permanently attached internal drive as the target (not a USB/removable drive — unplugging it breaks those folders). Folders containing links (junctions / symlinks) are refused outright; system folders and this app's own data folder cannot be moved.
disk.migrateLinkNote: Note: this path is a link (or lives inside one); its real location is {real}. If that real location shares a volume with the target, the move is refused (same-volume moves free no space).
disk.migrateNoTarget: No target drive available: plug in another drive, or use “Choose folder” to pick a location on another volume
disk.migrateConfirmMsg: Move “{name}” ({size}) to {target} and leave a directory junction in place: the old path keeps working while the data lives on the target drive.
disk.migrateRunningHint: The source stays usable while copying; avoid a forced shutdown once it switches over
disk.migrateDone: Moved to {target} (a junction is left behind){space}
disk.migrateLeftovers: Switched over, but {n} item(s) could not be removed (in use): {path}{space}
disk.rollbackConfirmMsg: Move the data back from {target} to {source} and remove the junction.
disk.rollbackDone: Rolled back: data is at {source} again{space}

registry.toolDiskDesc: Scan a drive or folder and rank the largest directories and files by size to see what is eating your space; read-only
